title: T034 second minimal synthetic provider and replaceability, version-rejection, and failure-isolation proof

scope.intended_use: Implement the capability-007 second minimal synthetic provider and its replaceability, version-rejection, and failure-isolation proof: one independently written bounded provider validated by the unchanged reusable T033 provider contract suite, with fail-closed unsupported-version and capability rejection that emits nothing and containment of a provider/route failure so an unrelated route stays active, bounded, and observable, without changing any accepted production source or the runtime-target inventory.
boundaries: Bounded capability-007 prototype scope: one second-provider fixture header/source and three additive t034-<kind> test drivers.

No change to the accepted provider boundary, composition, loopback provider, T033 reusable suite, T030 contract, T031 gateway, or T032 client; no TCP listener, AF_INET/AF_INET6 socket, DNS, resolver, TLS, external peer, legacy binary, production workload, compiled/linked gRPC runtime, or new admitted dependency.

T034 changes are limited to the new src/xverse/xcom/fixtures/synthetic_provider.{hpp,cpp} path, the new tests/xcom/contract_suites/second_provider_*_tests.cpp drivers, the additive build wiring, the T034 work products, the engineering records, and the inherited provenance refresh.
success_criteria: Every accepted T034 software requirement is traced to the applicable X-Verse system anchor, component, unit, code, unit/integration/validation tests and measured evidence.

The second provider passes the unchanged reusable provider contract suite; unsupported version and capability are rejected fail-closed with zero emission; an unrelated route stays active, bounded, and observable after a provider/route failure.
The three additive t034-<kind> suites and the preserved platform suites pass in the offline admitted build.
Independent review and strict delivery validation bind the exact candidate before acceptance.
